messages.author: 4742ff1f9fc5f9ca
messages.subject: Using R Markdown to generate text from a data.frame?
parts:
Dear D-RUG,

I am tasked with helping construct a program for an upcoming conference and I'm hoping to bring some automation to the task to save time in the future. I have a data.frame with authors, affiliations, titles, and abstracts and I want to create a list of abstracts that I will look nice and conform to a pre-determined format.

I've attached an example abstract in the chosen format, along with an example data.frame so you can see what I'm dealing with.

I've started using R Markdown to try and work this out, but I am new to this and am not sure if this is the best strategy. However, I like the idea of using R because everyone seems to use it these days and I think it should be able to handle this task. Any suggestions for how to get the info in the attached data.frame into the format of the attached document would be much appreciated.

Many thanks,

Matt

messages.author: f8f554f3c8aec296
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Using R Markdown to generate text from a data.frame?
parts:
Good idea. I'm not certain from your email what your exact goal is an how it differs from the example you provided. Maybe the footnotes?

In any case, here's a suggestion to generate some footnotes (modified from the chunk in your Rmd)

d <- read.csv( "attendee_example.csv", stringsAsFactors=F )
d$authors <- NULL

column_names <- names(d)
footnotes <- paste0(" (", letters, ")" )
basenames <- c("author", "affiliation")

for(i in 1:nrow(d)){
  footnoted_lists <- lapply(basenames, function(basename) {
    auths <-d[i,grep(paste0(basename, "\.[0-9]"), column_names)]
    auths <- auths[auths != ""] # trim empty
    paste0(auths, footnotes[1:length(auths)], collapse=", ")
  })
     cat(paste0("**",footnoted_lists[[1]],"**","   ",
         d$title[i],"   ","*",
         footnoted_lists[[2]],"*","   ",
         d$abstract[i],"   ", 
     " ", " "))
}
